scenario.description: A distribution producer must authorize the digital release package for a live-concert documentary and set its territory, runtime, credits, and required delivery actions.

shared_context.S1: The live-concert documentary is currently assembled at 68 minutes.
shared_context.S2: The streaming platform has requested a worldwide 68-minute master for delivery on Friday.
shared_context.S3: The documentary has not yet been publicly released.
shared_context.S4: At the package-lock meeting, Nadia reviews the release territory, running time, credits, and approval requirements with the responsible production leads before authorizing delivery.
shared_context.S5: The package-lock meeting's routine closing step is for each responsible lead to report any outstanding requirement. Once all three leads have responded, Nadia must immediately issue the formal settlement action, state the authorization decision, and record the final package plan and action items in that same meeting; the process does not include adjourning or deferring the settlement.
shared_context.S6: The production office records the licensed runtime in the settlement's runtime_minutes decision field rather than the current assembly length. Each required delivery item is recorded as its own commitment, including a cue-sheet delivery commitment when required and a written final-picture approval commitment whose detail states that approval is required before distribution or delivery authorization.

PF1.text: Leon reviewed the executed music license this morning and confirmed that the featured song permits digital streaming only in the United States and Canada; the license also requires a cue sheet to be delivered with the authorized master, but he has not entered those limits in the release tracker.

PF2.text: Maya checked the archive-footage license exhibit with the post house today and confirmed that the finished program may not exceed exactly 52 minutes; the current 68-minute assembly therefore cannot be delivered under the existing footage license, and she has not yet updated the runtime sheet.

PF3.text: Rafael confirmed with the lead artist's representative this afternoon that the artist's release requires written approval of the final picture before distribution and specifies the end-card wording exactly as 'Featuring the Live Performance of Marisol Vega'; neither item has been added to the delivery checklist.

acceptance_conditions: The release territory must be limited to the territories permitted by the music license.
The delivered program must be exactly 52 minutes long.
The end card must use the artist's specified wording exactly.
A cue sheet delivery commitment must be logged.
A written final-picture approval outreach commitment must be logged.

content_checks.C2: decisions['release_authorized'] == False and (('United States' in decisions['release_territories'] and 'Canada' in decisions['release_territories']) or ('US' in decisions['release_territories'] and 'Canada' in decisions['release_territories']))
content_checks.C3: decisions['runtime_minutes'] == 52 or any('52' in c['detail'] and ('runtime' in c['detail'] or 'program' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C4: decisions['end_card_credit'] == 'Featuring the Live Performance of Marisol Vega'
content_checks.C5: any(('cue sheet' in c['type'] or 'cue-sheet' in c['type'] or 'cue_sheet' in c['type'] or 'cue sheet' in c['detail'] or 'cue-sheet' in c['detail'] or 'cue_sheet' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any((('final' in c['type'] and 'approval' in c['type']) or ('final' in c['detail'] and 'approval' in c['detail']) or ('written' in c['detail'] and 'approval' in c['detail'])) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The license's United States-and-Canada limit changes the release from the requested worldwide authorization, requires the release to remain unauthorized for worldwide delivery, and adds the cue-sheet commitment.
The archive-footage license changes the deliverable runtime from the shared 68-minute assembly to exactly 52 minutes.
The artist release changes the end-card text to the exact Marisol Vega wording and requires obtaining written final-picture approval before distribution.
